headline: Bank of Canada Retains Two Percent Inflation Target in Mandate Renewal
summary: The Bank of Canada and the federal government agreed to keep a target of two percent inflation at the core of the central bank's mandate.
why: Inflation targets anchor long-term monetary policy frameworks and guide market expectations regarding future interest rate paths.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Reaffirming the inflation target maintains continuity for monetary policy expectations.
